title: (0Day) Microsoft Windows DirectComposition Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of DirectComposition in the win32kbase driver. Crafted parameters to a system call can trigger a dereference of a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
